faces.name: Nessian Wanderer
faces.oracle_text: Constellation — Whenever an enchantment you control enters, look at the top three cards of your library. You may reveal a land card from among them and put that card into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

triggered.raw_text: Whenever an enchantment you control enters, look at the top three cards of your library. You may reveal a land card from among them and put that card into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

effects.text: You may reveal a land card from among them and put that card into your hand
